primary_metric: unit edge costs, shortest path in hops for all three representations

axial.node: one saved certified interval with its canonical candidate ID
axial.edge: nonempty exact intersection, including endpoint contact or collinear overlap
axial.spatial_display: full interval coloured by node value

segment.node: one nonzero exact atomic interval after splitting selected lines at intersections and overlap endpoints
segment.edge: shared exact endpoint, continuation or turn
segment.coincident_geometry: merge identical atoms, inventory all owners
segment.spatial_display: atomic interval coloured by node value

convex.node: one certified maximal polygon identified by canonical hash
convex.coincident_geometry: unique registry hashes; boundary-only contact excluded
convex.spatial_display: colour polygons in canonical order with transparency; companion interior marker map encodes individual values

angular_segment_supplement.edge_cost: deflection between incoming and outgoing directions; straight = 0 degrees
angular_segment_supplement.quantisation: nearest microdegree, round half to even
angular_segment_supplement.shortest_path_metric: minimum sum of angular costs, then minimum hops, implemented by integer cost n*microdegrees+1
angular_segment_supplement.zero_cost: true straight transitions contribute zero degrees to depth and one hop to the tie-break; zero-length intervals are excluded
angular_segment_supplement.scope: undirected segment adjacency; a walk may change segments twice at the same junction, so this is an adjacency measure and is not doorway routing

mean_depth: mean shortest-path distance over reachable nonself nodes; null for isolates
integration: reachable fraction times 1/(1+mean depth); zero for isolates
choice: endpoint-excluded undirected betweenness; sum of fractions of tied shortest paths through the node, divided by (n-1)(n-2)/2; zero for n<3
intelligibility: Pearson r across graph nodes, degree vs integration; null if constant or fewer than two observations
disconnected: report component sizes and reachable counts; unreachable pairs contribute zero to choice and reduce integration via reachable fraction
equal_paths: split credit equally across tied paths; angular ties require equal angle and hops
overlap_attributes: exact rational areas reported on convex edges; not used as weights
geometry: rational decisions throughout; rendered coordinates and angular trigonometry use floats
